actions.text: The sniper drinks from a mango juice box.
The sniper puts down the juice box and aims his rifle.
Cut to a wide shot of a man hanging from a high beam in front of a pipe organ.

camera.text: Close-up, static shot of the sniper.
Wide shot, slow push-in on the hanging man.

analysis.performance_note: Excellent contrast between the sniper's casual juice-drinking and the sudden tension of aiming. The wide shot of the hanging man is framed beautifully.
analysis.summary: A sniper drinks from a juice box before aiming his rifle. The shot cuts to a man hanging from a beam in a ruined cathedral.
